A tool library project in use, based on native C#, does not require any third-party libraries.
This project features many practical functions, such as support for multiple Base encoding types, common operations for files/folders, high-precision timers, encryption, etc.

releaseNotes:
QingYi.Core Official Release

This major release delivers a comprehensive suite of utilities for encoding, encryption, compression, and high-performance I/O, boasting exceptional cross-platform compatibility and support for a vast range of .NET frameworks.

Key Highlights:
- Broad Compatibility: Now supports netstarnard1.5; netstandard1.6; netstandard2.0; netstandard2.1; net45; net451; net452; net46 net461; net462; net47; net471; net472; net48; net481; netcoreapp2.0; netcoreapp2.1; netcoreapp2.2; netcoreapp3.0; netcoreapp3.1; net5.0; net6.0; net7.0; net8.0; net9.0; net5.0-windows; net6.0-windows; net7.0-windows; net8.0-windows; net9.0-windows; net9.0-browser
- Extended Codec Suite: Static methods for encoding and decoding over 15 different bases, from Base2 to Base128, including Auto Base detection
- Cryptography & Compression: Integrated support for AES, DES, TripleDES, Deflate, and LZ77

New Features & Additions:
- Codec Library: Added comprehensive static methods for encoding and decoding: Base2, Base8, Base10, Base16, Base26, Base42, Base52, Base56, Base58, Base62, Base64, Base91, Base92, Base94, Base100, Base122, and Base128. Includes Auto Base detection
- Cryptography: Integrated support for symmetric encryption and decryption using DES, AES, and TripleDES algorithms. Expanded static helper methods for AES
- Compression: Added support for Deflate and LZ77 compression algorithms
- High-Performance I/O: New high-performance file read/write and download functions
- System Utilities: Added a high-precision timer and methods to retrieve power plan information

Optimizations:
- Significant performance optimizations for Base10, Base62, and other codec implementations
- Optimized file I/O methods for better efficiency and stability
- General library-wide performance and stability improvements

Breaking Changes & Refactoring:
- Namespace Change: The QingYi.Core.String namespace has been renamed to QingYi.Core.Codec
- Removed Features: The Network functionality and legacy compression methods have been removed (These are planned for a future, separate library)
- Temporarily Hidden: Registry-related functions have been temporarily hidden from the API

Compatibility & Infrastructure:
- Extensively Expanded Framework Support: As listed in Key Highlights
- Updated the library icon and significantly improved documentation
